test_case: Phantom Brew whitebox flows › cart coupon applies a visible discount to the order total
estimated_root_cause: Coupon UI shows success/10% OFF but total stays ¥418 instead of discounted ¥380; discount is not applied to order total calculation/rendering.
recommended_action: Fix coupon discount computation or total recomputation after apply; verify rounding and displayed total update.

test_case: カートページ › 数量の-ボタンで数量が減る
estimated_root_cause: Click waits on .qty-btn '+' and never becomes actionable; likely page not ready, covered element, or async rendering race.
recommended_action: Wait for cart items/controls to be visible and enabled before clicking; use a more stable selector than first().

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › ステータスが「preparing」に進む
estimated_root_cause: Status progression is delayed nondeterministically; test expects preparing within a fixed short window while status remains received.
recommended_action: Poll until preparing with a longer timeout or control the backend/status timer in test setup.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › 最終的にステータスが「completed」になる
estimated_root_cause: Order status never advanced from received within 15s, consistent with random/slow async status updates rather than a deterministic assertion mismatch.
recommended_action: Stub or drive status transitions deterministically, or increase timeout and assert intermediate progress.

test_case: レート制限テスト › 通常のページ遷移でエラーが出ない
estimated_root_cause: Selector 'h1, .product-card' matches many elements, causing Playwright strict mode violation unrelated to app behavior.
recommended_action: Assert on a single stable locator or use .first()/count-based checks instead of a multi-match strict locator.
